scope: Five pinned files read whole; pyproject parsed using standard TOML parser. No package installation/build or top-level pff import executed.

findings.detail: pff.main parses explicit argv but dispatches only if len(sys.argv)>=2. A valid explicit argument list can therefore return None without invoking the requested subcommand when the host process has no arguments. Static source finding.
pff eagerly imports every command including ECC/resiliency modules before argument parsing. Even hash-only usage/help depends on importability of unrelated command dependencies.

Coverage selection omits pff.py and explicitly excludes filetamper.py, ecc_speedtest.py and profiler code. A high configured coverage result cannot establish CLI facade or corruption-generator correctness.

tox default environments include py27/py32/py34 while package requires Python>=3.7. Default deps include pytest only, while pyproject requires pytest-cov plugin. Legacy environments are configuration, not proof of supported runtime tests.

tox changes cwd to a temp directory but passes the source repository path explicitly to pytest; whether tests exercise installed package depends on import resolution. Cwd isolation alone is insufficient evidence.
requirements.txt allows reedsolo>=2.0.0a, pyproject requires >=2.0.0b1. Dependency manifests do not define the same minimum ECC library version.
